_note: Raid-Helper spec name -> CoA class + spec.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A Raid-Helper event carries NO class field. Its
`signUps[].className` is the ROLE (Tank / Melee / Ranged / Healer /
Support) and the only identity a signup has is `specName`. So the spec
name is the join key onto the 21 classes, and it has to be exact.
WHY IT IS NEARLY EMPTY NOW. An earlier revision guessed four mappings by
elimination and got two of them WRONG. The mirror turned out to carry the
real spec names all along, in `spell-<id>.json -> skill_line.name`, and
`class_specs()` now reads those. Every one of the guild's 69 configured
specs matches natively, so nothing needs an alias.
The two bad guesses, recorded so nobody repeats them:
`blackknight`  guessed Knight of Xoroth / Defiance.
ACTUALLY Witch Hunter / Black Knight. The db.exil.es tree
label for that Witch Hunter tree is `Darkness`, which is
not a spec name at all.
`grovekeeper`  guessed Primalist / Life -- right class, but `Life` is a
tree label and not the spec. The spec IS Grovekeeper.
`houndmaster` was left unresolved rather than guessed, which was the right
call: it is Witch Hunter's own spec, and the tree label for it (
`WitchKnight`) is wrong too. Guessing between Darkness and WitchKnight
would have had a 50% chance of misfiling every Houndmaster signup, and
Witch Hunter's only interrupt is spec-locked.
Add an entry ONLY when a Raid-Helper spec name genuinely differs from the
skill_line name -- e.g. a guild that types its own labels into the event
template. `spec: null` means the CLASS is certain and the SPEC is not; the
page counts those as class-present / spec-unresolved and says so on
screen rather than picking one.
